class FakeResp:
    """Minimal fake response for urlopen."""

    def __init__(self, status, body_dict=None, headers=None):
        self.status = status
        self.body = json.dumps(body_dict).encode() if body_dict is not None else b""
        self._headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in (headers or {}).items()}

    def read(self):
        return self.body

    def getheader(self, name, default=None):
        return self._headers.get(name.lower(), default)

    def info(self):
        return self._headers

                      "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:0{i}Z", "status": "captured"}

            "next_cursor": None,
